proposal.research_rationale: Count consecutive A/B/C triples in which the candidate is present in all three draw states.
proposal.hypothesis: The score defined by the attached formal DSL expression is hypothesized to rank candidates with greater chronological test-draw overlap than the uniform random 6-of-60 baseline.
proposal.exact_definition: Formal DSL definition: score(candidate) = AGGREGATE_HISTORY_TRIPLES[COUNT](((candidate_present_in_A AND candidate_present_in_B) AND candidate_present_in_C)).
proposal.inputs: Only direction-isolated 6-of-60 records strictly earlier than each chronological scoring cutoff; the cutoff draw and every later record are excluded.
proposal.output_rule: Score every member of the complete supported number pool with the formal DSL expression; rank by descending score and break equal-score ties by ascending value.
proposal.parameter_policy: All constants in the validated DSL expression are frozen before sealed evaluation; sealed outcomes cannot tune them.
proposal.selection_policy: The formal DSL definition is fixed before sealed evaluation. Discovery and time-ordered development data may be used for selection; sealed outcomes and post-target records may not be used.
proposal.falsification_criterion: Reject the hypothesis if chronological forward evaluation and time-ordered cross-validation do not outperform the uniform-random 6-of-60 baseline within reported uncertainty. Reverse results remain retrospective stress tests only.
known_risks: A descriptive historical association may not persist in later draws.
The bounded DSL cannot represent every possible interpretation of this research-family label.
Selection and evaluation are exploratory and do not establish predictive advantage.
